notes.title: Patch 2 - Achievement Unlock Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Version Update Notes: 
* Fixed a bug where the final achievement (Achievement 20 - "True Endings") was not unlocking. 

If you had previously completed any endings and did not have this achievement unlock, you can reload your save in the Epilogue, or start a New Game and this achievement should now unlock.

Thank you, everyone!

notes.title: Version Update and OST News
notes.content:
This version addresses a few bugs and adds some edits to the character dialogue. 

* Fix issue with Achievements not unlocking.
* Fix some typos and adjust character dialog.

We will also soon be adding the OST package to Steam at a discount for people who have already purchased the game.

Thank you and please let us know if you find any other issues!
-slimehunter from mangotronics
